title: Scalar comparison in the canonical image factorization
statement: For any map a:Λ→Λ' of commutative condensed rings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-coefficient-change], any standing separated finite-type k-scheme X in positive characteristic different from the auxiliary prime ell [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], any locally closed immersion i:S→X, and any Q in the ordinary unbounded derived category D(Λ_S), there is an isomorphism (i_!Q)_{Λ'} ≅ i_!(Q_{Λ'}) in D(Λ'_X). Both locally closed extension functors are exactly the canonical image-factorization composite of [def-sfb-scalar-perfect-generators]: derived exact open extension along i.toImage, followed by the ordinary right-derived module pushforward along i.imageι. Neither Q nor its scalar change is required constructible or of finite Tor amplitude. The coefficient rings and the scalar change functor are those of [def-sfb-scalar-six-coefficient-interfaces].

proof.text:
give S and the image closure the induced k-structures. The immersion
into the Noetherian finite-type X makes them separated finite type and
quasi-compact. Apply scalarSixPullback, clause (2), to the induced immersion in the
over-category. Its normalized comparison uses the published section-module locally
closed extension. The internal/sectionwise equivalence carries this extension to
openImmersionLowerShriek along i.toImage followed by the closed module pushforward
along i.imageι: the coefficient action is restriction along the published adjunct,
as fixed by ScalarSixGeometry.pushNormalization. Exactness identifies its termwise
derived functor with the ordinary open derived functor followed by the closed right
derived functor. Conjugate the normalized beta comparison by these two canonical
identifications, and evaluate at Q. This gives the stated isomorphism for arbitrary
coefficient maps, without flatness or a constructibility assumption on Q. The nodes used by this native-presentation argument are [det-prop-scalar-six-pullback].

theorem sfbCanonicalExtensionScalarComparison
    {Λ Λ' : ScalarSixRing.{u}} (a : Λ ⟶ Λ')
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ell)]
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
    (S : Scheme.{u}) (i : S ⟶ X.left) (hi : IsImmersion i)
    (Q : DerivedCategory (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules Λ.X S)) :
    Nonempty ((scalarSixChange a X.left).obj
        ((sfbLocallyClosedDerivedExtension Λ i hi).obj Q) ≅
      (sfbLocallyClosedDerivedExtension Λ' i hi).obj ((scalarSixChange a S).obj Q))
